title: docs(changeset): date the rotted "keeps its own copy" clause in the 5993 note
body:
Fixes #9772

Clause-②: no

`.changeset/5993-button-shared-icon-resolver.md`'s final paragraph asserts that
`renderers/basic/icon.tsx` "keeps its own copy deliberately and is untouched". The first
clause is false today. It was **true when written**, so this is ROTTED, not BORN FALSE —
the repair **keeps the sentence, dates it, and names the falsifier**. Correcting it outright
(objectui#9753's repair, for a claim that was never true) would delete the record that the
sentence was once true, and with it the reason this change left `ui:icon` alone.

This is a **pending** changeset: the body publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next
release. The repair lands in the pending body while it is still pending. ⛔ Nothing here
touches release PR objectui#5400 or any file it owns.

## Both readings taken here, neither inherited

**Write-time ref — `194fae184` (2026-08-25).**

```
git log -L 42,44:.changeset/5993-button-shared-icon-resolver.md --oneline
```

walks to exactly one commit — `194fae184` `refactor(components): resolve ui:button icons
through the shared resolver (#6350)` — and shows the hunk as `--- /dev/null`, i.e. the file
was created there and the paragraph has never been edited since. `git blame -L 42,44` on the
same file agrees on all three lines.

**At that ref the clause was TRUE.**

```
git show 194fae184:packages/components/src/renderers/basic/icon.tsx
```

That file defines `function toPascalCase`, holds `const iconNameMap` carrying the single
`Home -> House` entry, and resolves with `(icons as any)[mappedIconName]` against
`lucide-react`'s runtime record. A grep of the same blob for `resolve-icon` / `resolveIcon` /
`describeIconLookup` returns nothing: it imported no part of the shared resolver. So it did
keep its own copy.

**Falsifier — `e176053094` (2026-09-03), `refactor(...): one lucide icon-name seam, seven
resolvers down to one (#7491)`.**

Three independent `git log -S` probes, each scoped to that one file, converge on it and on
no other commit after the write-time ref:

| probe | first commit after `194fae184` |
|---|---|
| `git log -S "from '../action/resolve-icon'"` | `e176053094` |
| `git log -S "function toPascalCase"` | `e176053094` |
| `git log -S "const iconNameMap"` | `e176053094` |

Why that one **and not another**:

- `git log --oneline --reverse 194fae184..HEAD -- packages/components/src/renderers/basic/icon.tsx`
  lists exactly four commits, and `e176053094` is the **first** of them — the file was not
  touched at all between the write-time ref and it, so nothing in between can have falsified
  the clause.
- Its diff on that file removes `function toPascalCase`, `const iconNameMap` and
  `(icons as any)[mappedIconName]`, and adds the shared import, in one commit. At
  `e176053094^` the own copy is still present and the shared import still absent.
- The other three commits in that range — `e304a4ef76`, `c6198c27bd` and `57c07f0028` — move
  **no** line matching the own-copy or import pattern. In particular **objectui#9770
  (`57c07f0028`) is not the falsifier**, though it touched the same file most recently; on a
  card whose subject is provenance, naming it would have been a fresh false statement.

**Corroboration inside the thing being described.** The file's own docblock beside the lookup
already speaks in the past tense — it says this file *carried* its own `toPascalCase` +
`iconNameMap` + `icons[...]`, and that the guarded name *used to* reach this file's own
`toPascalCase`. The changeset was still asserting the opposite in the present tense. The
falsifier's own commit body independently records that it kept `ui:icon`'s `SquareDashed`
placeholder and objectui#5631 warning at the call site.

## Only the first clause was repaired

"Is untouched" is scoped to objectui#5993's own change — *that change didn't touch it* — not
to "never touched again", so a later commit touching the file does not falsify it. It is left
**byte-identical**, and the amendment says so explicitly so the next reader does not
re-litigate it. The reason clause (`SquareDashed` placeholder + objectui#5631 warning, which
the shared resolver does not do) is likewise untouched and still true, per the falsifier's own
body. The diff is **append-only: 20 insertions, 0 deletions.**

## The amendment does not plant a fact that will rot again

It contains no bare present-tense assertion about today's tree. Where it points at the current
implementation it names where to re-derive it — *read what `renderers/basic/icon.tsx` imports
from `renderers/action/resolve-icon`, and the docblock beside that lookup* — and every
historical reading carries its ref and its date. No `path:line` citation is added (AGENTS.md
#11); `pnpm check:new-line-citations` is green.

## Before/after probe of the changed prose — whitespace-tolerant, both controls

Changeset prose wraps near 88 columns, so a line-anchored `grep -F` reads 0 on text that is
plainly present. The instrument therefore normalises every whitespace run to a single space
across the whole file and counts literal occurrences. Same instrument, same corpus
(`.changeset/5993-button-shared-icon-resolver.md`) at base `42234b1a2` and at the head.

| probe | before | after | line-anchored `-F`, before/after | expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SUBJECT — new prose, spans a wrap | 0 | 1 | 0 / 0 | 0 / 1 ✅ |
| SUBJECT-2 — falsifier named, spans a wrap | 0 | 1 | 0 / 0 | 0 / 1 ✅ |
| **LIT CONTROL** — pre-existing sentence, spans the wrap between "`ui:icon`" and "draws a `SquareDashed` placeholder" | 1 | 1 | 0 / 0 | 1 / 1 ✅ |
| **ABSENT CONTROL** — in neither tree | 0 | 0 | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 ✅ |

The lit control spans a wrap deliberately, and the fourth column is the point: the naive
line-anchored instrument reads **0** for a sentence that is verbatim in both trees. Probe exit
code captured to disk before any pipe: `PROBE_EXIT=0`.

## Changeset grade for this change — measured from a build, both controls

`@object-ui/components` ships `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "LICENSE"]`; minus
`*.md` and `LICENSE*`, the published executable surface is `dist/`. Built for real first —
`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` then
`pnpm --filter @object-ui/components build`, both under the shared verify lock, both
`VERDICT command-exit 0` — then grepped over the 212 files of `packages/components/dist`:

| probe | hits | exit |
|---|---|---|
| new prose (`the reason is the half worth releasing`) | 0 | 1 |
| falsifier sha `e176053094` | 0 | 1 |
| **positive control** — published symbol `describeIconLookup` | 1 file (`dist/renderers/action/resolve-icon.d.ts`) | 0 |

The positive control lands, so instrument and corpus are live; the subject does not, so nothing
this change moves is published executable source ⇒ **no changeset is owed**, which is also what
`node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` prints on its own: *"0 of them published source of a
package the release covers … no changeset is owed"*, exit **0**.

Stated rather than glossed over: the changeset **body** does publish, into
`packages/components/CHANGELOG.md`, which is in `files[]` — and is excluded from the criterion
as `*.md` by the repo's own rule. That is the whole reason this repair is urgent rather than
cosmetic, and it is not a changeset-owing surface.

## Gates — exit codes captured to disk before any pipe

| gate | exit |
|---|---|
| `check-changeset-overwrite` | **0** — reports this as its documented **case 2** (*"You are CORRECTING a declaration on purpose … prose that no longer matches"*): `M .changeset/5993-button-shared-icon-resolver.md`, *declared at base* `@object-ui/components: patch`, *declares now* `@object-ui/components: patch` — no declaration lost, frontmatter unmoved |
| `check-changeset-presence` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-claims` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-no-major` | 0 |
| `check-changeset-fixed` | 0 |
| `check-pending-changeset-literals` | 0 |
| `check-control-bytes` | 0 |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` | 0 |
| `grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'` on the changed file | 1 (clean) |

No test or typecheck is owed: the diff touches one markdown file and no package source. The
repo-wide run belongs to CI.

## Serial constraint, re-taken over the open-PR 全集 immediately before the first write

19 open pull requests enumerated through the REST proxy, every one's file list read. Exactly
**one** touches `.changeset/5993-button-shared-icon-resolver.md`: **objectui#5400**, the release
PR, which consumes every pending declaration. Re-taken immediately before the push:
`state=open, merged=False, merged_at=None`. ⇒ the window is open and no concurrent branch edits
this file. ⛔ objectui#5400 is not touched by this PR. The sibling work on objectui#9781 is on
`.changeset/8171-…` and shares no file with this.

If objectui#5400 merges before this lands, this card needs re-triage — the remedy channel
becomes a docs-only PR on a release-owned tree.
